calculation.description: After an unusually large positive VIX daily move, buy the cross-sectional losers over the prior three completed sessions; no signal outside shock dates. VIX is lagged and observation-only.

validation.regime_notes: Shock-date observations only: 2020-22 ICIR -0.0923 (32 dates), 2023-24 +0.2814 (29), 2025-26 +0.2397 (39), 2027-to-date +0.3188 (7). Results use all 15 tradable instruments and >=8 names/date; sparse events and small cross-section warrant conservative interpretation.
